record.bible_text: Woe<WH0480> is me! for I am as when they have gathered<WH0625> the summer fruits<WH07019>, as the grapegleanings<WH05955> of the vintage<WH01210>: <FI>there is<Fi> no cluster<WH0811> to eat<WH0398><WTH8800>: my soul<WH05315> desired<WH0183><WTH8765> the firstripe fruit<WH01063>. <RF>when...: Heb. the gatherings of summer<Rf>

The good<WH02623> <FI>man<Fi> is perished<WH06><WTH8804> out of the earth<WH0776>: and <FI>there is<Fi> none upright<WH03477> among men<WH0120>: they all lie in wait<WH0693><WTH8799> for blood<WH01818>; they hunt<WH06679><WTH8799> every man<WH0376> his brother<WH0251> with a net<WH02764>. <RF>good: or, godly, or, merciful<Rf>

That they may do evil<WH07451> with both hands<WH03709> earnestly<WH03190><WTH8687>, the prince<WH08269> asketh<WH07592><WTH8802>, and the judge<WH08199><WTH8802> <FI>asketh<Fi> for a reward<WH07966>; and the great<WH01419> <FI>man<Fi> , he uttereth<WH01696><WTH8802> his mischievous<WH01942> desire<WH05315>: so they wrap it up<WH05686><WTH8762>. <RF>his...: Heb. the mischief of his soul<Rf>

The best<WH02896> of them <FI>is<Fi> as a brier<WH02312>: the most upright<WH03477> <FI>is sharper<Fi> than a thorn hedge<WH04534>: the day<WH03117> of thy watchmen<WH06822><WTH8764> <FI>and<Fi> thy visitation<WH06486> cometh<WH0935><WTH8804>; now shall be their perplexity<WH03998>.

Trust<WH0539><WTH8686> ye not in a friend<WH07453>, put ye not confidence<WH0982><WTH8799> in a guide<WH0441>: keep<WH08104><WTH8798> the doors<WH06607> of thy mouth<WH06310> from her that lieth<WH07901><WTH8802> in thy bosom<WH02436>.

For the son<WH01121> dishonoureth<WH05034><WTH8764> the father<WH01>, the daughter<WH01323> riseth up<WH06965><WTH8801> against her mother<WH0517>, the daughter in law<WH03618> against her mother in law<WH02545>; a man's<WH0376> enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> <FI>are<Fi> the men<WH0582> of his own house<WH01004>.<CM>
Therefore I will look<WH06822><WTH8762> unto the LORD<WH03068>; I will wait<WH03176><WTH8686> for the God<WH0430> of my salvation<WH03468>: my God<WH0430> will hear<WH08085><WTH8799> me.

Rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> not against me, O mine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>: when I fall<WH05307><WTH8804>, I shall arise<WH06965><WTH8804>; when I sit<WH03427><WTH8799> in darkness<WH02822>, the LORD<WH03068> <FI>shall be<Fi> a light<WH0216> unto me.

I will bear<WH05375><WTH8799> the indignation<WH02197> of the LORD<WH03068>, because I have sinned<WH02398><WTH8804> against him, until he plead<WH07378><WTH8799> my cause<WH07379>, and execute<WH06213><WTH8804> judgment<WH04941> for me: he will bring me forth<WH03318><WTH8686> to the light<WH0216>, <FI>and<Fi> I shall behold<WH07200><WTH8799> his righteousness<WH06666>.

Then <FI>she that is<Fi> mine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , and shame<WH0955> shall cover<WH03680><WTH8762> her which said<WH0559><WTH8802> unto me, Where is the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>? mine eyes<WH05869> shall behold<WH07200><WTH8799> her: now shall she be trodden down<WH04823> as the mire<WH02916> of the streets<WH02351>. <RF>Then...: or, And thou wilt see her that is mine enemy, and cover her with shame<Rf> <RF>shall she...: Heb. she shall be for a treading down<Rf>
<FI> In<Fi> the day<WH03117> that thy walls<WH01447> are to be built<WH01129><WTH8800>, <FI>in<Fi> that day<WH03117> shall the decree<WH02706> be far removed<WH07368><WTH8799>.

<FI> In<Fi> that day<WH03117> <FI>also<Fi> he shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> even to thee from Assyria<WH0804>, and <FI>from<Fi> the fortified<WH04693> cities<WH05892>, and from the fortress<WH04693> even to the river<WH05104>, and from sea<WH03220> to sea<WH03220>, and <FI>from<Fi> mountain<WH02022> to mountain<WH02022>. <RF>and <FI>from<Fi> the fortified cities: or, even to the fortified cities<Rf>

Notwithstanding the land<WH0776> shall be desolate<WH08077> because of them that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> therein, for the fruit<WH06529> of their doings<WH04611>. <RF>Notwithstanding: or, After that it hath been<Rf><CM>

Feed<WH07462><WTH8798> thy people<WH05971> with thy rod<WH07626>, the flock<WH06629> of thine heritage<WH05159>, which dwell<WH07931><WTH8802> solitarily<WH0910> <FI>in<Fi> the wood<WH03293>, in the midst<WH08432> of Carmel<WH03760>: let them feed<WH07462><WTH8799> <FI>in<Fi> Bashan<WH01316> and Gilead<WH01568>, as in the days<WH03117> of old<WH05769>. <RF>Feed: or, Rule<Rf>
According to the days<WH03117> of thy coming<WH03318><WTH8800> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714> will I shew<WH07200><WTH8686> unto him marvellous<WH06381><WTH8737> <FI>things<Fi> .

The nations<WH01471> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> and be confounded<WH0954><WTH8799> at all their might<WH01369>: they shall lay<WH07760><WTH8799> <FI>their<Fi> hand<WH03027> upon <FI>their<Fi> mouth<WH06310>, their ears<WH0241> shall be deaf<WH02790><WTH8799>.

They shall lick<WH03897><WTH8762> the dust<WH06083> like a serpent<WH05175>, they shall move<WH07264><WTH8799> out of their holes<WH04526> like worms<WH02119><WTH8801> of the earth<WH0776>: they shall be afraid<WH06342><WTH8799> of the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>, and shall fear<WH03372><WTH8799> because of thee. <RF>worms: or, creeping things<Rf>

Who <FI>is<Fi> a God<WH0410> like unto thee, that pardoneth<WH05375><WTH8802> iniquity<WH05771>, and passeth by<WH05674><WTH8802> the transgression<WH06588> of the remnant<WH07611> of his heritage<WH05159>? he retaineth<WH02388><WTH8689> not his anger<WH0639> for ever<WH05703>, because he delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> <FI>in<Fi> mercy<WH02617>.

He will turn again<WH07725><WTH8799>, he will have compassion<WH07355><WTH8762> upon us; he will subdue<WH03533><WTH8799> our iniquities<WH05771>; and thou wilt cast<WH07993><WTH8686> all their sins<WH02403> into the depths<WH04688> of the sea<WH03220>.

Thou wilt perform<WH05414><WTH8799> the truth<WH0571> to Jacob<WH03290>, <FI>and<Fi> the mercy<WH02617> to Abraham<WH085>, which thou hast sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> unto our fathers<WH01> from the days<WH03117> of old<WH06924>.<CM>
